atlases.name: space-science-grid-4x4
atlases.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: original bitmap sprite atlas for a children's activity app.
Input image is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, not an edit target. Match its charming soft handdrawn colored-pencil / crayon children's storybook aesthetic, warm gentle muted colors, subtle watercolor paper feel WITHIN objects, simple recognizable silhouettes, thin soft brown outlines where useful.
Create a SQUARE sprite atlas containing EXACTLY 16 separate illustrations on a PURE WHITE #FFFFFF background in a perfectly regular 4-column by 4-row grid. No gridlines or boxes. Each object is centered at the center of its equal square cell. Each illustration fits wholly inside the central 70% width and 70% height of its cell with generous untouched white margins. All cells same size. Equal-size illustrative icons, not actual relative scale. Absolutely no text, letters, labels, numerals, watermark, borders, shadows beneath objects, overlapping objects, extra decorative objects, or background texture. Use square canvas. Flat scanner-view illustration assets. The listed words below describe subjects only and must never be printed.

Exact cell order left to right:
ROW 1: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars.
ROW 2: Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune.
ROW 3: comet, telescope, satellite, microscope.
ROW 4: horseshoe magnet, ice cube, rock, clear water glass.
Planet details: Mercury gray cratered sphere; Venus creamy pale golden cloud-covered sphere; Earth blue oceans with green continents; Mars rust-red sphere; Jupiter warm broad horizontal stripes and distinctive red spot; Saturn pale yellow sphere with broad tilted elliptical rings; Uranus pale aqua sphere; Neptune deep blue sphere. Do not add faces to planets. Planets visually distinct. These are artistic object icons, not an educational diagram. Telescope small classic instrument on tripod; satellite small central box with two solar panel wings; microscope recognizable single-eyepiece classroom microscope; magnet red horseshoe with gray ends; ice cube translucent pale blue; rock irregular gray-brown stone; water glass a simple transparent cylindrical drinking glass half-filled with pale blue water, no handle.

review.content_order: All 48 requested subjects are present in the requested row-major order. No labels or grid lines.
review.style: All three closely match the existing colored-pencil/crayon storybook reference.
review.family: Adults, elderly adults, older/younger siblings, swaddled baby, and three-person family are distinct. Hand and foot each show five digits. Shoulder is clear headless upper torso with visible shoulder joint.
review.objects: Mug has a handle and differs clearly from transparent water glass. School scissors have rounded ends.
integration_notes: Raw backgrounds appear white but sampled corners range RGB 253–255, so they are not mathematically pure #FFFFFF.
Nominal layout is 4x4; some objects occupy more than the requested central 70% of a cell.
Saturn ring extends slightly beyond the nominal right edge of its cell (around x=640 vs cell edge 627). Use a slightly wider source crop or recenter before uniform atlas packing.
Do not blind slice to 313-pixel integer cells: native resolution is 1254x1254, so nominal cells are 313.5x313.5 pixels.
